On Tuesday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. Little by little, things began to change. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, trains fill up before spring festival.

Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Owen keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. Her Just Giving page topped £2,000.
